title: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Act 1975

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXVI OF 1975
ACT XXVI OF 1975
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 15th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the State Bank of Pakistan
(Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once,

Amendment of section 17, Act XXXIII of 1956

ACT XXVI OF 1975
ACT XXVI OF 1975
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 15th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 17,
Act XXXIII of 1956.---In the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 (XXXIII of
1956), in section 17, in clause (16), in sub clause (a), the words for a
period not exceeding three months" shall be omitted.
